thig5.12:1.1: duggatāhaṃ pure āsiṃ vidhavā ca aputtikā | vinā mittehi ñātīhi bhattacoḷassa nādhigaṃ. || ||
thig5.12:2.1: pattaṃ daṇḍaṃ ca gaṇhitvā bhikkhamānā kulā kulaṃ | sītuṇhena ca ḍayhantī satta vassāni cāri 'haṃ. || ||
thig5.12:3.1: bhikkhuniṃ puna disvāna annapānassa lābhiniṃ | upasaṃkamma avocaṃ pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ. || ||
thig5.12:4.1: sā ca maṃ anukampāya pabbājesi Paṭācārā | tato maṃ ovaditvāna paramatthe niyojayi. || ||
thig5.12:5.1: tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā akāsiṃ anusāsaniṃ | amogho ayyāya ovādo tevijja mhi anāsavā. || || Candā. ||
